_meta.description: Essential guitar chord dataset for visual and audio coaching. Strings array is [E2, A2, D3, G3, B3, E4] (low to high). Values: 'x'=muted (-1), 0=open, 1-N=fret number. Fingers: 1=index, 2=middle, 3=ring, 4=pinky, 0=none.

chords.name: Em
chords.description: Standard open E minor chord — middle finger on A string fret 2, ring finger on D string fret 2.

chords.name: C
chords.description: Open C major — ring on A fret 3, middle on D fret 2, index on B fret 1.

chords.name: G
chords.description: Open G major — middle on low E fret 3, index on A fret 2, ring on high e fret 3.

chords.name: D
chords.description: Open D major — index on G fret 2, ring on B fret 3, middle on high e fret 2.

chords.name: Am
chords.description: Open A minor — middle on D fret 2, ring on G fret 2, index on B fret 1.

chords.name: E
chords.description: Open E major — middle on A fret 2, ring on D fret 2, index on G fret 1.

chords.name: A
chords.description: Open A major — index on D fret 2, middle on G fret 2, ring on B fret 2.

chords.name: F
chords.description: Barre F major — index barres fret 1, ring on A fret 3, pinky on D fret 3, middle on G fret 2.

chords.name: Dm
chords.description: Open D minor — index on high e fret 1, middle on G fret 2, ring on B fret 3.
